```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 16_factorial_anova_calculate_2x2
title: >
  Calculate 2x2 ANOVA Quiz
questions:
  - id: number_of_f_tests
    type: multiple-choice
    prompt: >
      In a two-by-two factorial ANOVA, how many F ratios are usually calculated?
    options:
      - text: >
          Three: Factor A, Factor B, and the interaction
        correct: true
      - text: >
          One: only the interaction
      - text: >
          Two: one for each cell
      - text: >
          Four: one for each condition
    explanation: >
      A two-factor ANOVA tests two main effects and one interaction.
```
